title: Drunk Mom with Two Young Kids Almost Crashes and Assaults Cops!
description:
On March 7th, 2024, in Ohio, chaos ensued on the interstate as officers encountered a blue Honda Civic swerving dangerously. Behind the wheel was a suspect, later identified as Brittany Clemis-Jones, with two young passengers in the back. Despite attempts to reason with Clemis-Jones, her uncooperative behavior escalated the situation. Officers struggled to remove her from the vehicle, leading to a violent altercation. The scene grew even more intense when Clemis-Jones struck Sergeant Szalay, causing serious injury.

As the confrontation unfolded, officers worked tirelessly to ensure the safety of all involved, including the distressed children in the backseat. Despite the suspect's resistance, law enforcement maintained control, eventually securing her in handcuffs. Emergency medical services were called to tend to both Clemis-Jones and the injured officer. A subsequent inventory of the vehicle revealed a loaded firearm, further complicating the situation. Clemis-Jones was eventually transported to a medical facility for evaluation and treatment, where she continued to exhibit uncooperative behavior. The incident resulted in a slew of charges against Clemis-Jones, underscoring the severity of her actions and the challenges faced by law enforcement in maintaining public safety. The suspect was charged with a range of offenses, including endangering children, felonious assault, resisting arrest, and receiving stolen property.
